name: Fivefold Sahn
summary: Five colored bays follow a rounded courtyard wall, expressing the five daily prayers around a common sanctuary.
why: The round enclosure, prayer hall and minaret are physically joined. The domed hall and entrance align with the court at x=54. Five evenly spaced inlays follow the same radial geometry and remain contained in the thick courtyard wall.
risk: The five bays are distinct at 48px and above. At 24px they become a rhythmic colored edge rather than individually countable markers.
sub1: Prayer rhythm follows the court wall
sub2: A clear opening beneath a domed hall
theme: Five daily prayers around one court
